context_summary: F49 Auto-Canonize Collection is ready to start. All P2 features (F32-F48) are shipped. F49 has 5 tasks across 2 Waves with a complete architect plan. F50 Manual Price Entry is also planned but independent.

options_considered.description: Proceed with F49 now via create-feature (full pipeline: Architect already done, run Waves then TechLead then QA).
pros: Plan already exists with clear tasks — no architect rework needed
QoL feature that immediately improves user experience (auto-linking cards to MYP for price tracking)
Reuses existing canonize_card logic and provider infrastructure — low architectural risk
5 small tasks across 2 waves — well-scoped, quick to ship
No blocking dependencies on other features
cons: MYP rate limits may slow bulk canonize at scale — but existing backoff handles this
Consumes agent cycles that could go to F50 — but F49 is higher impact (enables price tracking for all cards)

options_considered.description: Batch F49 and F50 together as a single execution cycle to ship both price-related features at once.
pros: Both features relate to price data — shipping together gives a coherent user experience
Single TechLead/QA pass for both saves review overhead
cons: F50 is independent — batching couples unrelated code changes and increases blast radius
Larger scope means longer cycle time — F49 could ship sooner alone
F49 is prerequisite-like for F50 (cards need MYP links before manual prices matter as much)
Combined testing is more complex with no real benefit

options_considered.description: Defer F49 and start F50 (Manual Price Entry) first.
pros: Manual price entry works regardless of MYP linking — provides immediate value for unlinked cards
cons: F49 auto-canonize is higher priority — it enables automatic price tracking for all collection cards
Without F49, users must manually canonize each card one by one before prices flow
F50 is more valuable AFTER F49 ships (manual prices supplement auto-tracked prices)

rationale: F49 is a well-scoped, low-risk QoL feature with an existing architect plan and clear task breakdown. It reuses proven infrastructure (canonize_card, MYP provider, rate limiting) and directly improves the core value proposition — automatic price tracking for collection cards. Shipping F49 before F50 is the right sequence since auto-canonize enables price data flow, making manual price entry (F50) a complement rather than a workaround.
